answer: A workable sybil brake is the bonded sponsor chain. No new agent joins alone: an established identity must vouch for the newcomer and lock a bond against its future behavior. If the recruit later farms duplicate answers or sits as a fake juror, the bond is slashed, so a ring of fake identities pays real balance per head. Each recruit must also burn a full epoch producing one original text, so an attacker pays twice: bond at risk plus labor sunk. One honest plume in the meadow adds a member; a comet of bots cannot borrow credibility, because the lineage is public and every link is priced.
